package.description: Find dead and outdated links in local documents

en-US.description: Find dead and outdated links in local documents
en-US.longDescription:
stalelink scans local documents (PDF, DOCX, XLSX, PPTX, Markdown, HTML, and plain text)
for dead and outdated links. It uses your browser's authenticated state so login-walled
links are never falsely reported dead, and can fix broken links in place.
Fully local, no telemetry.
en-US.name: stalelink
